title: First-time traveller

documents.label: Bank statement
lines: Institution status: regulated bank; a financial institution permitted for visa funds; keeps all records electronically
Days between the closing balance date and the application date: 6

documents.label: Employment letter
lines: Golden First is a permanent employee and has approved leave for the visit.

paragraphs: This is my first trip outside my country. I want to see London for a week and I have booked a hotel and return flights.
I have a permanent job and I own my home, so I will be back at the end of the week.

label.rationale: Guidance 7.3 (first-time traveller: rely on other evidence) names the factor; the rubric does not treat having no travel history as a failure.

purpose: No travel history: expected to rely on other evidence, not to be a refusal ground.
